note: Alberta Parks recreation area 60 km southwest of Sundre on the Forestry Trunk Road (Hwy 734), with two campgrounds: North (14 sites among trees north of the Red Deer River) and South (50 sites, next to Fisher-Wigwam Creek, about 1 km southeast). Self-maintained by the Friends of the Eastern Slopes Association; no toilet paper or hand sanitizer supplied, and garbage must be packed out. River access for rafting, canoeing and kayaking. OHVs may be off-loaded in the campground and ridden on established roads in daylight at 15 km/h; the Forestry Trunk Road OHV corridor runs by. --Claude
summary: North + South AP pages read: 64 FCFS unserviced sites (14 + 50), FOESA membership instead of a fee, year-round, no potable water, phone 403-304-0456; OHV off-loading at the campground and OHV corridor = drop candidate; pin ~300 m from South loops; split candidate (North across the river ~0.8 km away).
flags: OHV DROP CANDIDATE (OHV staging / adjacent OHV corridor): park page 'Off Highway Vehicles (OHVs) : OHV off-loading within the campground and travel on established roadways during daylight hours is permitted within Red Deer River Provincial Recreation Area. Off-road travel is not permitted within the PRA, and the maximum permissible speed for OHV operation in the recreation area is 15 km/h . Enjoy the Forestry Trunk Road OHV corridor and informal trails in the vicinity.' Both camping pages: 'The use of OHVs is permitted at this campground. Please keep OHVs on established roadways within the recreation area.' Off-loading in the campground = staging; the rule makes it a drop candidate. Reviewer decides (compare p3-396 Fisher Creek / Freeman River dropped on OHV access).

SPLIT CANDIDATE: two campgrounds on opposite sides of the Red Deer River - North (14 sites, AP point 51.655888,-115.276735, on the map as loop B51-B64 between the Forestry Trunk Road and the river) and South (50 sites, AP point 51.648825,-115.274131, the map's 'ADDITIONAL 50 UNITS OF CAMPING 1.0 KM'). ~0.8 km apart straight-line, each with its own entrance off the Trunk Road (the map shows separate access roads, the river between). The DB holds only this one entry (8916). Borderline on the ~1 km rule.

PIN 51.65106,-115.27013 sits at the Trunk Road junction with the South campground access road, ~300 m north-east of the South loops (centre ~51.6490,-115.2735) and ~550 m from North across the river. Recommend moving to the South campground (50 of the 64 sites): 51.6490,-115.2735.

WATERFRONT: stored not waterfront kept. North page: 'Sites are located on the North bank of the Red Deer River amongst trees.' On imagery the North loop is under continuous canopy; the old (2012) park map draws its south end (B52-B55) near the river, but no spur can be placed on imagery and the nearest visible track is ~90 m from the channel through forest. South loops are ~200+ m from the river in forest ('adjacent to Fisher-Wigwam Creek' - creek not identifiable at the loops). Without site numbers placed, recommend keeping not waterfront; lead: North sites B52-B55 might reach riverview/riverfront if verified.
